_comment: Whisper ggml models. url is pinned to a Hugging Face commit; sha256 and bytes come from the repository's LFS pointer files (read Oct 22, 2026). To use another mirror or revision, put a file of this shape at <config dir>/ai/catalog.json or point CAPTUREMANN_AI_CATALOG at one: it replaces this list. ram_mb is the memory the model needs while it runs, in MB, from the model table of the whisper.cpp README (https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp, read Oct 24, 2026: tiny ~273 MB, base ~388 MB, small ~852 MB, medium ~2.1 GB); its disk column is in MiB, bytes here come from the files.

models.label: Tiny
models.hint: Fastest, lowest accuracy. Good for quick drafts on any machine.

models.label: Base
models.hint: Fast, fine for clear speech in a quiet room.

models.label: Small
models.hint: Balanced accuracy and speed. The best choice for most recordings.

models.label: Medium
models.hint: Most accurate, slow. Best for accents and noisy audio.

models.label: Large
models.hint: The most accurate and the slowest. For difficult audio and many languages on a Mac with plenty of memory.
